name: Central Depository Services (India) Ltd
description: Central Depository Services (India) Ltd (CDSL) is India's leading securities depository and the first depository in Asia-Pacific to surpass 115 million active demat accounts. Functioning as essential market infrastructure, CDSL holds equities, bonds, mutual fund units, and commodities in electronic form, enabling seamless depository clearing and settlement across Indian stock exchanges.

company_profile.summary: Central Depository Services (India) Ltd (CDSL) is India's leading securities depository and the first depository in Asia-Pacific to surpass 115 million active demat accounts. Functioning as essential market infrastructure, CDSL holds equities, bonds, mutual fund units, and commodities in electronic form, enabling seamless depository clearing and settlement across Indian stock exchanges.

revenue_breakup.desc: Annual listing and custody fees paid by publicly listed and unlisted corporate issuers.
Per-debit settlement charges levied whenever shares are sold from retail and institutional demat accounts.
Electronic investor KYC verification and Aadhaar authentication for capital market intermediaries.
Pledge fees, IPO corporate action fees, and electronic AGM voting services.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 100% vital market infrastructure across all Indian capital market intermediaries
moats_and_strengths: Duopoly market structure alongside NSDL, holding over 77% market share in total active Indian demat accounts.
Asset-light financial infrastructure utility delivering incredible operating EBITDA margins (>60%).
Direct beneficiary of the ongoing secular financialization of Indian household savings into equity markets.
Completely debt-free balance sheet with robust cash balances and high return on equity (ROE > 30%).
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Active Demat Accounts: 115+ Million accounts • Depository Intermediaries: 600+ Depository Participants (DPs)

promoter_governance.parent_group: BSE Ltd & Institutional Shareholding (Market Infrastructure Institution)

bullish_triggers: Record pace of new retail demat account additions (2M–3M new accounts opened per month in India).
Surge in corporate IPOs and mandatory dematerialization of private unlisted enterprises.
High dividend payouts and capital returns supported by zero-debt cash flows.
bearish_risks: Cyclical drop in daily equity cash market trading volumes during prolonged market consolidations.
SEBI regulatory tariff rationalizations capping transaction or account opening fees.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)

faqs.question: What is the MTF margin required to trade Central Depository Services (India) Ltd (CDSL) on NSE?
faqs.answer: Central Depository Services (India) Ltd (CDSL) is approved under SEBI's Margin Trading Facility (MTF) with an initial maintenance margin requirement of approximately 20%. This enables swing traders to access 5.0x purchasing power on eligible Indian brokerage platforms.
